integrity: A self-contained transfer-resolvent and cotangent partial-fraction argument is supplemented by independent exact Ehrhart and polynomial-integration checks; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to unweighted unit-edge fans and anchored-coordinate volumes, not intrinsic Euclidean volumes or weighted families; an unindexed equivalent prior volume calculation remains a bibliographic risk. Finite tests are not substitutes for the infinite proof.
title: Exact fan-graph Lipschitz-dual volumes and alternating spectral growth
